text:
Anya (PM): Quick triage — follow-up work after Search Snippets launch. Two customer regressions flagged (AcmeCorp, BetaBank) + a few enhancement asks. Need to decide what goes as a hotfix vs next minor. Can folks chime in with repro/ETA and whether rollback is necessary?
Mike (eng): I can reproduce AcmeCorp emoji issue locally. Looks like a unicode normalization path that's choking tokenization.
Sam (eng): BetaBank latency looks real — KV-cache miss spikes when query length > 512. Tagging tracing duty.
Elaine (design): Acme provided screenshots where the snippet UI cuts off mid-sentence; might be related to the tokenization bug.
Anya (PM): Given Acme is blocked in prod, I'm leaning hotfix for that one. BetaBank latency seems like an ops/config change candidate for follow-on unless it proves urgent. Thoughts on rollback window?
Mike (eng): Repro steps for Acme bug:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/snippets -d '{"query": "I love pizza 🍕 and emoji tests"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Response truncates after the emoji token. I can try a fix — estimate 1-2d if it's a tokenizer patch, faster if it's a normalization toggle. If I can't get a patch in today, we should consider rolling the snippet service back to the previous image.
Sam (eng): For BetaBank, I'll enable extra tracing on canary and pull tail latency graphs. If it's a config policy for KV caching (sequence thresholds), that would be a 1–3 hour config change, no code.
Jon (SRE): Note that rollback requires manual approval outside of the automated canary. We also have a deploy window at 18:00 UTC — pushing a hotfix after that will be riskier.
Anya (PM): Proposal: 1) Hotfix pipeline for Acme emoji bug (owner: Mike). If no shipped patch by EOD, schedule rollback for next safe window. 2) BetaBank — Sam to triage; if it's config-only, do a fast fix and notify BetaBank. 3) Other enhancement asks (Spark per-tenant ranking) move to backlog for Q2. Approve?
Mike (eng): :thumbsup: Opening WIP PR now, will link in thread. If anyone can test the repro on staging, please ping.
Sam (eng): Started traces, will post graphs in ~45m. If I confirm a cache threshold regression, I'll propose the exact config delta.
Elaine (design): I'll collate customer screenshots and add to INF-2332 so we have visual repro.
Anya (PM): Please add brief notes to tickets: INF-2332 (emoji/tokenization) and INF-2333 (long-query latency). Assign owners and expected ETA. I'll coordinate comms with Acme and BetaBank.
DeployBot: Deploy window scheduled 2026-03-21T18:00Z — approvals pending.
Jon (SRE): If Mike needs rollback after 18:00 UTC, we'll need an incident on-call handoff. Call it out early so we can staff.
Anya (PM): Thanks everyone. Action items: Mike -> patch + PR; Sam -> perf traces + config proposal; Elaine -> screenshots to INF-2332; Jon -> rollback readiness if needed. I'll update customers after we have a PR or config decision.
